HEALTH_EAT.meaning_ja: マーク、「超美味しいもの」だけ選んで食べなきゃダメだよ！
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_en: Mark, you must only choose and eat 'JMT' (Very Delicious Food)!

HEALTH_EAT.text: 마크 '먹방' (먹는 방송) 하는 거 보고 싶다! '뇸뇸'.
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_ja: マークの「モクバン」（食べる放送）が見たい！「もぐもぐ」。
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_en: I want to see Mark doing an 'eating broadcast' (Mukbang)! 'Nom nom'.

HEALTH_EAT.meaning_ja: 「ちゃんとご飯食べてる」、マーク？「しっかり」食べてね！
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_en: Are you eating well, Mark? Eat 'heartily'!

HEALTH_EAT.meaning_ja: マーク、コンビニの「神組み合わせ」じゃなくて、「高級な」ものを食べてね！
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_en: Mark, eat 'fancy' stuff, not convenience store 'honey combinations' (Kkul-johab)!

HEALTH_EAT.meaning_ja: マーク、今日のランチの「認証ショット」は「必須」だよ！
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_en: Mark, today's lunch 'proof shot' (Injeung-syot) is 'essential'!

HEALTH_CARE.meaning_ja: マーク、病気になったら「ダメなものはダメ」！健康が「最高」！
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_en: Mark, 'it won't happen' if you get sick! Health is 'the best'!

HEALTH_CARE.meaning_ja: 「マーク・リー」の健康は「国家代表レベル」で管理されるべき！
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_en: Mark Lee's health must be managed at a 'national athlete level'!

HEALTH_CARE.text: 마크 감기 걸리면 '킹받네' (짜증나)! 절대 안 돼!
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_ja: マークが風邪をひいたら「ムカつく」（心配で）！絶対だめ！
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_en: If Mark catches a cold, it's 'annoying' (King-bat-ne - in a concerned way)! Absolutely not!

HEALTH_CARE.meaning_ja: マーク、暖かくして「マスク」は必須だよ！
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_en: Mark, dress warmly and a 'mask' is essential!

HEALTH_CARE.meaning_ja: マークの「コンディション」がいつも「グッド」であることを祈るよ、「私の愛しい人」。
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_en: I pray Mark's 'condition' is always 'good', 'my love'.

GREET_JOB.meaning_ja: マーク、「お疲れ様」！あなたは本当に「プロ」だよ！
GREET_JOB.meaning_en: Mark, you 'worked hard'! You are truly a 'pro'!

GREET_JOB.meaning_ja: 今日マークは「熱心に働いた」！「退勤」は「定時退勤」お願いね！
GREET_JOB.meaning_en: Mark 'worked hard' (Yeol-il) today! Please 'clock out' exactly on time (Kal-toe)!

GREET_JOB.meaning_ja: マーク、「超ヤバい」！今日のステージは「最高だった」！
GREET_JOB.meaning_en: Mark, you were 'so cool' (Gaejjeoreo)! Today's stage 'killed it' (Jiryeotda)!

GREET_JOB.meaning_ja: マークの努力は「真実そのもの」！本当に「リスペクト」します。
GREET_JOB.meaning_en: Mark's effort is 'truly true'! I really 'respect' you.

GREET_JOB.meaning_ja: マーク、今日の「テンション」は「すごかった」！ゆっくり休んで！
GREET_JOB.meaning_en: Mark, today's 'tension/energy' was 'amazing' (O-jyeotda)! Rest well!

LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_ja: ファン・ロンジュン、私の心臓の宿主だよ！
LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_en: Huang Renjun, you are the host of my heart!

LOVE_GENERAL.text: 런쥔이 없인 못 살아, 내 삶의 낙이야!
LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_ja: ロンジュンなしでは生きられない、私の人生の喜びだよ！
LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_en: I can't live without Renjun, you are the joy of my life!

LOVE_GENERAL.text: 런쥔아, 너는 내 인생의 폼 미친 존재야.
LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、君は私の人生で「調子ぶっ壊れた」（最高に素晴らしい）存在だ。
LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_en: Renjun, you are the 'crazy awesome' presence in my life.

LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_ja: ロンジュンは私の最愛のアイドル、略して「推し」だよ。
LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_en: Renjun is my ultimate bias idol, 'Choi-ae' for short.

LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_ja: キング・ロンジュン愛してる、私の心の中に保存！
LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_en: King Renjun, I love you, 'saving' you in my heart!

LOVE_DEEP.meaning_ja: ロンジュンに過度な没頭中、出口はない。
LOVE_DEEP.meaning_en: I'm over-immersed in Renjun, there is no exit (from this love).

LOVE_DEEP.meaning_ja: 私の全財産と心を捧げるよ、ロンジュン。
LOVE_DEEP.meaning_en: I dedicate all my assets and heart, Renjun.

LOVE_DEEP.text: 런쥔아, 널 향한 내 마음은 지구를 뚫어.
LOVE_DEEP.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、君への私の心は地球を貫く。
LOVE_DEEP.meaning_en: Renjun, my heart for you pierces the Earth.

LOVE_DEEP.meaning_ja: 宇宙ほど愛してる、銀河系を壊すくらい！
LOVE_DEEP.meaning_en: I love you as much as the universe, crushing the galaxy!

LOVE_DEEP.meaning_ja: ロンジュンがいなければ私、気絶レベル。本物の愛だよ。
LOVE_DEEP.meaning_en: If there's no Renjun, I'm about to faint. This is real love.

REQ_MARRY.text: 런쥔아, 지금 당장 혼인신고 하러 가자!
REQ_MARRY.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、今すぐ婚姻届を出しに行こう！
REQ_MARRY.meaning_en: Renjun, let's go register our marriage right now!

REQ_MARRY.meaning_ja: ロンジュンは私のもの！今日から1日目（付き合い始め）決定だ。
REQ_MARRY.meaning_en: Renjun is mine! Today is decided to be Day 1.

REQ_MARRY.text: 황런쥔, 내 삶의 짝꿍, 평생 같이 살자.
REQ_MARRY.meaning_ja: ファン・ロンジュン、私の人生のパートナー、一生一緒に住もう。
REQ_MARRY.meaning_en: Huang Renjun, my life partner, let's live together forever.

REQ_MARRY.text: 런쥔아, 우리 부부의 합법적인 미래를 응원해.
REQ_MARRY.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、私たち夫婦の合法的な未来を応援してるよ。
REQ_MARRY.meaning_en: Renjun, I'm cheering for our legal future as a married couple.

REQ_MARRY.text: 런쥔아, 도장 찍자! 내 삶에 런쥔 박제.
REQ_MARRY.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、判子を押そう！（契約しよう）私の人生にロンジュンを永久保存。
REQ_MARRY.meaning_en: Renjun, let's stamp it! Preserving Renjun in my life (forever).

MISS_YOU.text: 런쥔이 못 봐서 현기증 난단 말이야!
MISS_YOU.meaning_ja: ロンジュンが見られなくて目眩がするんだってば！
MISS_YOU.meaning_en: I'm saying I'm dizzy because I can't see Renjun!

MISS_YOU.text: 런쥔아, 내일 스케줄 없으면 지금 당장 와줘.
MISS_YOU.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、明日スケジュールがなかったら今すぐ来て。
MISS_YOU.meaning_en: Renjun, if you don't have a schedule tomorrow, come right now.

MISS_YOU.text: 런쥔이 실시간 앓이 중, 당장 영접 기원.
MISS_YOU.meaning_ja: ロンジュンにリアルタイムで恋い焦がれ中、今すぐ会えることを祈願。
MISS_YOU.meaning_en: I'm yearning for Renjun in real-time, praying for an immediate meeting.

MISS_YOU.text: 런쥔이 얼굴 못 본 지 오조오억 년 된 듯.
MISS_YOU.meaning_ja: ロンジュンの顔を見てから五兆五億年経った気がする。
MISS_YOU.meaning_en: It feels like 5.5 billion years since I saw Renjun's face (Exaggerated).

MISS_YOU.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、会いたくて死にそうだ。
MISS_YOU.meaning_en: Renjun, I miss you so much I could die.

PROMISE_FOREVER.text: 런쥔아, 평생 네 옆에서 주접 떨게 해줘!
PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、一生あなたの隣でオタクのおしゃべりをさせて！
PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_en: Renjun, let me excessively praise/flirt next to you forever!

PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_ja: 私は一生ロンジュンの「固定ピック」（永遠の推し）だ！
PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_en: I am Renjun's 'fixed pick' (fixed favorite) forever!

PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_ja: ロンジュンの未来、私が一生責任を持つ。
PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_en: I will take responsibility for Renjun's future forever.

PROMISE_FOREVER.text: 런쥔아, 우리의 영원한 역사를 지금부터 박제하자.
PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、私たちの永遠の歴史を今から永久保存しよう。
PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_en: Renjun, let's archive our eternal history starting now.

PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_ja: 私たちの永遠の同行、ロンジュン、頼もしい！
PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_en: Our eternal companionship, Renjun, you are reliable!

CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_ja: ファン・ロンジュン誕生祭、地球が感激する日！
CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_en: Huang Renjun's birth day, the day the Earth is moved!

CONGRAT_BDAY.text: 런쥔아, 태어나줘서 고마워. 복 많이 받아!
CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、生まれてきてくれてありがとう。たくさんの福を受けてね！
CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_en: Renjun, thank you for being born. Receive much luck!

CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_ja: ロンジュンの誕生日、今日は無条件でロンジュンタイム！
CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_en: Renjun's birthday, today is unconditionally Renjun Time (meaning the focus is only on him)!

CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、誕生日だから今日は君が一番最高だよ。
CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_en: Renjun, since it's your birthday, you are the best today.

CONGRAT_BDAY.text: 런쥔이 생일 축하! 오늘 컨디션 폼 미쳤다!
CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_ja: ロンジュン誕生日おめでとう！今日のコンディションは「調子ぶっ壊れた」（最高）！
CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_en: Happy birthday Renjun! Today's condition is crazy good!

CHEER_UP.meaning_ja: ファン・ロンジュン、今日のステージ最高だった！（舞台を破った）行ってみよう！（さらに頑張ろう）
CHEER_UP.meaning_en: Huang Renjun, you slayed the stage today! Let's go!

CHEER_UP.text: 런쥔이, 네가 최고! 누가 뭐래도 내가 지켜.
CHEER_UP.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、君が最高！誰が何と言おうと私が守る。
CHEER_UP.meaning_en: Renjun, you are the best! No matter what anyone says, I'll protect you.

CHEER_UP.text: 런쥔이의 미모는 복지, 우리가 널 지켜줄게.
CHEER_UP.meaning_ja: ロンジュンの美貌は福祉、私たちが君を守ってあげるよ。
CHEER_UP.meaning_en: Renjun's visuals are welfare, we will protect you.

CHEER_UP.text: 런쥔아, 항상 잘하고 있어. 걱정은 넣어둬!
CHEER_UP.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、いつも上手くやっているよ。心配はしまっておいて！
CHEER_UP.meaning_en: Renjun, you are always doing well. Put your worries away!

CHEER_UP.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、頑張って！私たちは君を「無限動力」で後押しするよ。
CHEER_UP.meaning_en: Renjun, cheer up! We will push you with 'infinite power'.

PRAISE_GOD.text: 런쥔이의 실력, 이미 갓벽함 그 자체.
PRAISE_GOD.meaning_ja: ロンジュンの実力、すでに「神＋完璧」そのもの。
PRAISE_GOD.meaning_en: Renjun's skill is already 'Godly perfection' itself.

PRAISE_GOD.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、君はただの「神」だ。「ゴッド・ロンジュン」認定！
PRAISE_GOD.meaning_en: Renjun, you are simply 'God'. I acknowledge God Renjun!

PRAISE_GOD.meaning_ja: ファン・ロンジュン、あえてあなたに敬拝します。
PRAISE_GOD.meaning_en: Huang Renjun, I dare to worship you.

PRAISE_GOD.text: 런쥔이의 존재 자체가 내 삶의 종교.
PRAISE_GOD.meaning_ja: ロンジュンの存在自体が私の人生の宗教だ。
PRAISE_GOD.meaning_en: Renjun's existence itself is the religion of my life.

PRAISE_GOD.meaning_ja: ロンジュンは天上界アイドル、近づきがたいオーラ。
PRAISE_GOD.meaning_en: Renjun is a celestial idol, with an untouchable aura.

PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_ja: ロンジュンの美貌はレアアイテム、国宝に指定して！
PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_en: Renjun's beauty is a rare item, designate it a national treasure!

PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、今日美貌の全盛期（리즈）を記録したね。
PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_en: Renjun, you hit your visual peak today.

PRAISE_VISUAL.text: 런쥔이에게 미모 유죄, 나의 마음을 훔쳤어.
PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_ja: ロンジュンに美貌の有罪、私の心を盗んだ。
PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_en: Renjun is guilty of beauty, he stole my heart.

PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_ja: ロンジュンの存在自体が「超得」（すごくラッキー）！
PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_en: Renjun's existence itself is a 'huge profit' (a great benefit)!

PRAISE_VISUAL.text: 황런쥔, 오늘 비주얼 폼 미쳤다. 대박 사건!
PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_ja: ファン・ロンジュン、今日のビジュアルは「調子ぶっ壊れた」（最高）。すごい事件だ！
PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_en: Huang Renjun, today's visual form is crazy good. What an incident!

PRAISE_FACE.meaning_ja: ロンジュンは「顔面天才」、ただ生きてるだけで十分だ。
PRAISE_FACE.meaning_en: Renjun is a 'face genius', just surviving is fine (because he is so handsome).

PRAISE_FACE.meaning_ja: ファン・ロンジュン、漫画を破って出てきた「マンチッナム」（漫画から飛び出た男）だよ。
PRAISE_FACE.meaning_en: Huang Renjun, you are a 'man-jjit-nam' ripped from a comic.

PRAISE_FACE.text: 런쥔이 얼굴이 바로 내 삶의 복지다!
PRAISE_FACE.meaning_ja: ロンジュンの顔がまさに私の人生の福祉だ！
PRAISE_FACE.meaning_en: Renjun's face is exactly the welfare of my life!

PRAISE_FACE.text: 런쥔이 얼굴 보다가 숨 멎을 뻔.
PRAISE_FACE.meaning_ja: ロンジュンの顔を見ていたら息が止まりそうになった。
PRAISE_FACE.meaning_en: I almost stopped breathing while looking at Renjun's face.

PRAISE_FACE.meaning_ja: ロンジュンのTゾーンは完璧そのもの。
PRAISE_FACE.meaning_en: Renjun's T-zone is perfection itself.

REQ_HEART.text: 런쥔아, 심장 어택 가능한 지목 부탁해!
REQ_HEART.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、心臓アタック可能な指差しをお願い！
REQ_HEART.meaning_en: Renjun, please point and give a heart attack (to me)!

REQ_HEART.text: 런쥔이표 깜찍한 '손가락 하트' 짤 생성 각!
REQ_HEART.meaning_ja: ロンジュン印の可愛い「指ハート」GIF作成の時だ！
REQ_HEART.meaning_en: Time to create a meme/GIF of Renjun's cute 'finger heart'!

REQ_HEART.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、愛嬌あふれる「小さなハート」を期待してるよ。
REQ_HEART.meaning_en: Renjun, I anticipate a burst of 'small heart' aegyo (cute display).

REQ_HEART.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、ファンサービスとして「キングハート」はどう？
REQ_HEART.meaning_en: Renjun, how about a 'huge heart' for fan service?

REQ_HEART.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、私だけに「保存（ポーズ）ハート」をお願い！
REQ_HEART.meaning_en: Renjun, please give me a 'saving heart' (a pose referencing a popular phrase) just for me!

HEALTH_EAT.text: 런쥔아, 오늘은 무조건 한우 '특수 부위' 먹자.
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、今日は無条件で韓牛の「特殊部位」を食べよう。
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_en: Renjun, let's unconditionally eat 'special cuts' of Hanwoo (Korean beef) today.

HEALTH_EAT.text: 런쥔아, 밥 잘 챙겨 먹고 힘내! 뇸뇸.
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、ご飯をしっかり食べて頑張って！もぐもぐ。
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_en: Renjun, take care of your meals and cheer up! Nom nom (yummy sound).

HEALTH_EAT.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、スケジュールが終わったらしっかり「蜂蜜の味」（すごく美味しい）の食事をしてね。
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_en: Renjun, after the schedule, have a hearty 'honey-sweet' meal.

HEALTH_EAT.text: 런쥔아, 맛있는 거 많이 먹고 '복근 유지'는 덤!
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、美味しいものをたくさん食べて、「腹筋維持」はおまけでね！
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_en: Renjun, eat lots of delicious things, 'maintaining abs' is a bonus!

HEALTH_EAT.text: 런쥔아, 오늘 점심은 'JMT' 맛집 투어 콜?
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、今日のランチは「JMT」（めちゃくちゃ美味しい）グルメツアーはどう？
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_en: Renjun, today's lunch, how about a 'JMT' (Super Delicious) restaurant tour?

HEALTH_CARE.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、「健康が一番」だよ。免疫力を気遣って！
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_en: Renjun, 'health is the best'. Take care of your immunity!

HEALTH_CARE.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、病気になったら姉/兄（ファン）の心が張り裂けるよ！
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_en: Renjun, if you are sick, my heart (as an older fan) rips apart!

HEALTH_CARE.text: 런쥔아, 감기 조심! '따뜻한 물' 많이 마셔.
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、風邪に気をつけて！「温かい水」をたくさん飲んで。
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_en: Renjun, beware of colds! Drink lots of 'warm water'.

HEALTH_CARE.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、今日から「防疫守則」を徹底的に守ってね。
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_en: Renjun, please strictly adhere to 'quarantine/safety rules' starting today.

HEALTH_CARE.text: 런쥔아, 절대 아프면 안 돼. '컨디션 관리' 잘하자.
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、絶対に病気になってはいけないよ。「コンディション管理」をしっかりしよう。
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_en: Renjun, you absolutely must not be sick. Let's manage your 'condition' well.

GREET_JOB.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、今日一日も「神＋完璧」に頑張ったね！お疲れ様！
GREET_JOB.meaning_en: Renjun, you worked 'God-perfectly' hard today too!

GREET_JOB.meaning_ja: ロンジュンのステージ、歴代級に「調子ぶっ壊れた」（最高）！お疲れ様。
GREET_JOB.meaning_en: Renjun's stage was historically 'crazy good'! You worked hard.

GREET_JOB.text: 런쥔아, 빨리 숙소 가서 '꿀잠' 자자. 퇴근길 최고!
GREET_JOB.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、早く宿舎に帰って「熟睡」しよう。退勤時が最高！
GREET_JOB.meaning_en: Renjun, hurry up and go to the dorm and 'sleep deeply'. The way home is the best!

GREET_JOB.meaning_ja: ロンジュンのおかげで「ヒーリング」完了！本当にお疲れ様。
GREET_JOB.meaning_en: Thanks to Renjun, 'healing' is complete! You worked very hard.

GREET_JOB.meaning_ja: ロンジュン、今日のスケジュール「オールキル」（全て完璧にこなした）認定！
GREET_JOB.meaning_en: Renjun, I acknowledge you 'all-killed' today's schedule (meaning you nailed everything)!

LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_ja: ジェノ、大好きぴょん！(可愛い擬音)
LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_en: Jeno, I love you *Piyong*! (Adding a cute sound effect)

LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_ja: 私の心臓の持ち主はもうジェノだよ！
LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_en: The owner of my heart is now Jeno!

LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_ja: ジェノは私の人生のビタミン！
LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_en: Jeno is the vitamin of my life!

LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_ja: ジェノファンはジェノしか知らない！
LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_en: JenFs (Jeno Fans) know only Jeno!

GREET_JOB.meaning_en: Chenle Sshibeomeok-eotne (dominated/crushed) the stage again today!

LOVE_GENERAL.text: 지성 사랑은 국룰, 네가 내 세상이야!
LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_ja: ジソンへの愛は国民のルール、あなたが私の世界よ!
LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_en: Jisung love is the national standard, you are my world!

LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_ja: ジソンが最高!マジで好き!
LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_en: Jisung is the best, I totally like you!

LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_ja: ジソン、あなたにハマってる、毎日夢中!
LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_en: Jisung, I'm falling for you, falling every day!

LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_ja: うちの赤ちゃん(ジソン)を広く愛してる!
LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_en: I love our baby (Jisung) widely!

LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_ja: ジソン、私の推しはあなただけ!
LOVE_GENERAL.meaning_en: Jisung, you are my only favorite!

LOVE_DEEP.meaning_ja: ジソン、あなたは私の心臓の無理数(ありえないほど貴重なもの)!
LOVE_DEEP.meaning_en: Jisung, you are the irrational number (impossible treasure) of my heart!

LOVE_DEEP.meaning_ja: パク・ジソン、あなたに魂までオールイン!
LOVE_DEEP.meaning_en: Park Jisung, I'm going all-in on you, even my soul!

LOVE_DEEP.meaning_ja: ジソンだけを見る。これが本物の愛だ。
LOVE_DEEP.meaning_en: I only look at Jisung. This is real love.

LOVE_DEEP.text: 지성아, 너는 내 삶의 비타민C 그 자체!
LOVE_DEEP.meaning_ja: ジソン、あなたは私の人生のビタミンCそのもの!
LOVE_DEEP.meaning_en: Jisung, you are Vitamin C itself in my life!

LOVE_DEEP.text: 너 없인 못 살아, 지성이는 쵝오!
LOVE_DEEP.meaning_ja: あなたなしでは生きられない、ジソンは最高!
LOVE_DEEP.meaning_en: I can't live without you, Jisung is the ultimate best!

REQ_MARRY.meaning_ja: ジソン、私たち婚姻届を出すタイミングだ!
REQ_MARRY.meaning_en: Jisung, it's definitely time for us to register our marriage!

REQ_MARRY.meaning_ja: ジソン、今日から1日目? 結婚する?
REQ_MARRY.meaning_en: Jisung, is today Day 1? Should we go marry?

REQ_MARRY.meaning_ja: パク・ジソン、私の未来はあなたの隣の席よ!
REQ_MARRY.meaning_en: Park Jisung, my future is the seat next to you!

REQ_MARRY.meaning_ja: ジソン、あなたのために印鑑を押す(結婚を確定する)!
REQ_MARRY.meaning_en: Jisung, I'm putting a stamp down (claiming you) for you!

REQ_MARRY.meaning_ja: 私と一生一緒に行こう、ジソン!
REQ_MARRY.meaning_en: Let's go together forever, Jisung!

MISS_YOU.meaning_ja: ジソン、めまいがするよ。早くカムバックして!
MISS_YOU.meaning_en: Jisung, I'm getting dizzy. Hurry back!

MISS_YOU.meaning_ja: 会いたすぎてわんわん泣いちゃった(泣き方を面白く表現したスラング)。
MISS_YOU.meaning_en: I missed you so much I cried loudly. (Internet meme for extreme crying.)

MISS_YOU.meaning_ja: ジソンの禁断症状が深刻だ。
MISS_YOU.meaning_en: Jisung withdrawal symptoms are severe.

MISS_YOU.meaning_ja: ジソン、あなたの存在自体がコンテンツ(ネタ)だよ!
MISS_YOU.meaning_en: Jisung, your existence itself is content/bait!

MISS_YOU.meaning_ja: ジソンなしでは生きられないジソン時代。
MISS_YOU.meaning_en: The Jisung Era where I can't live without Jisung.

PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_ja: ジソン、私たち一生、花道だけを歩こう!
PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_en: Jisung, let's only walk on flower paths forever!

PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_ja: 永遠にジソンだけを見つめるモードON!
PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_en: Forever on Jisung-gazing mode ON!

PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_ja: ジソンとシズニ(NCTファン)、最後まで一緒に行こう!
PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_en: Jisung and Czennies, let's go together until the end!

PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_ja: ジソン、ファン辞めなんてない。無限の愛!
PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_en: Jisung, there's no quitting the fandom. Infinite love!

PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_ja: ジソン、私たちは本物だ! 永遠でいよう!
PROMISE_FOREVER.meaning_en: Jisung, we are the real deal! Let's be forever!

CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_ja: ジソン、誕生日だからキングの中のキングで遊ぼう!
CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_en: Jisung, since it's your birthday, let's play like the ultimate King!

CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_ja: ジソンの誕生日は国家記念日に指定!
CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_en: Jisung's birthday is designated as a national holiday!

CONGRAT_BDAY.text: 우리 막둥이 생일, 기강 잡고 축하!
CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_ja: うちの末っ子の誕生日、しっかり気合を入れて祝う!
CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_en: Maknae's birthday, celebrating intensely and properly!

CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_ja: ジソン、生まれてきてくれて本当にありがとう!
CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_en: Jisung, thank you for being born, really!

CONGRAT_BDAY.text: 지성아, 생일 축하해! 떡 케이크 가자!
CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_ja: ジソン、お誕生日おめでとう! ライスケーキ(お餅のケーキ)行こう!
CONGRAT_BDAY.meaning_en: Happy Birthday, Jisung! Let's go get rice cake!

CHEER_UP.text: 지성아, 하고 싶은 거 다 해, 내가 쏜다!
CHEER_UP.meaning_ja: ジソン、やりたいこと全部やって、私が奢る!
CHEER_UP.meaning_en: Jisung, do everything you want to do, I'll pay for it!

CHEER_UP.meaning_ja: ジソン、自信をプンプン出せ! 信じてる!
CHEER_UP.meaning_en: Jisung, confidence bursting forth! I believe in you!

CHEER_UP.meaning_ja: エナガの末っ子、ファイティングモードON!
CHEER_UP.meaning_en: Little bird maknae, fighting mode ON!

CHEER_UP.text: 지성아, 기 죽지 마! 네가 제일 잘 나가!
CHEER_UP.meaning_ja: ジソン、気落ちしないで! あなたが一番かっこいい!
CHEER_UP.meaning_en: Jisung, don't lose heart! You are the coolest and most successful!

CHEER_UP.meaning_ja: パク・ジソンこそが、私たちの希望だよ!
CHEER_UP.meaning_en: Park Jisung is immediately our hope!

PRAISE_GOD.text: 지성 is 뭔들, 갓성 그 자체!
PRAISE_GOD.meaning_ja: ジソン is 何でも、ゴッド・ソンそのもの!
PRAISE_GOD.meaning_en: Jisung is whatever, God-Sung itself!

PRAISE_GOD.meaning_ja: ゴッド・ジソン、リスペクトします!
PRAISE_GOD.meaning_en: God Jisung, I respect you!

PRAISE_GOD.meaning_ja: パク・ジソン、人間レベルではいらっしゃらない。
PRAISE_GOD.meaning_en: Park Jisung, you are not on a human level.

PRAISE_GOD.meaning_ja: ジソンの存在自体が宗教だ。
PRAISE_GOD.meaning_en: Jisung's existence itself is a religion.

PRAISE_GOD.meaning_ja: ジソン、天才でしょ? 認めます!
PRAISE_GOD.meaning_en: Jisung, you are a genius, right? Acknowledge!

PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_ja: ジソン、美貌で伝説を打ち立てた!
PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_en: Jisung, you achieved a visual legend!

PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_ja: ジソンの美貌、実話ですか? 現実を否定する!
PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_en: Jisung's beauty, is this real life? Denying reality!

PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_ja: ジソン、あなたはただの光だよ!キラキラ!
PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_en: Jisung, you are just light! Shine!

PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_ja: ジソンも今日も美貌を一生懸命働かせている!お疲れ!
PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_en: Jisung's visual is working hard today! Good job!

PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_ja: パク・ジソンの外見、私だけが知りたい。
PRAISE_VISUAL.meaning_en: Park Jisung's looks, I want to be the only one who knows.

PRAISE_FACE.meaning_ja: ジソンの顔攻撃に死亡する運命!
PRAISE_FACE.meaning_en: Dying from Jisung's face attack!

PRAISE_FACE.meaning_ja: ジソン、ビジュアルがヤバい奴だ!(褒め言葉)
PRAISE_FACE.meaning_en: Jisung, your visual is crazy! (Extreme compliment)

PRAISE_FACE.meaning_ja: ジソンの顔は超面白い(見ていて楽しい)。剥製にすべき!
PRAISE_FACE.meaning_en: Jisung's face is extremely entertaining. We must preserve it (taxidermy it)!

PRAISE_FACE.meaning_ja: ジソン、顔がすぐに(存在の)蓋然性だ!(顔が良いから全て許される)
PRAISE_FACE.meaning_en: Jisung, your face is immediately the justification/plausibility!

PRAISE_FACE.meaning_ja: うちのジソン、顔面天才間違いありません!
PRAISE_FACE.meaning_en: Our Jisung, he is indeed a face genius!

REQ_HEART.meaning_ja: ジソン、指で愛を撃ってくれ!
REQ_HEART.meaning_en: Jisung, shoot love with your finger!

REQ_HEART.text: 애교 장인 지성, 깨물 하트 한번만!
REQ_HEART.meaning_ja: 愛嬌職人ジソン、噛みつきハートを一回だけ!
REQ_HEART.meaning_en: Aegyo master Jisung, just one biting heart pose!

REQ_HEART.meaning_ja: ジソン、小さくて大切なハートをお願い!
REQ_HEART.meaning_en: A small and precious Jisung heart, please!

REQ_HEART.meaning_ja: ジソン流のV字ハートを見せてください!
REQ_HEART.meaning_en: Show us Jisung's signature V-sign heart!

REQ_HEART.text: 지성아, 엄지척 하트 말고 손가락 하트!
REQ_HEART.meaning_ja: ジソン、親指ハートじゃなくて指ハート!
REQ_HEART.meaning_en: Jisung, not a thumbs-up heart, but a finger heart!

HEALTH_EAT.text: 지성아, 맛있는 거 많이 먹고 무대 찢자!
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_ja: ジソン、美味しいものをたくさん食べてステージをぶち破ろう!(最高のパフォーマンスをしよう)
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_en: Jisung, eat lots of delicious food and tear up the stage (kill the performance)!

HEALTH_EAT.meaning_ja: 今日のメニューはジソンのチョイスで行こう!
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_en: Let's go with Jisung's pick for today's menu!

HEALTH_EAT.meaning_ja: ジソン、ご飯の力でステージの伝説を打ち立てよう!
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_en: Jisung, let's achieve a stage legend with the power of food!

HEALTH_EAT.meaning_ja: ジソンが食べるものは全てハチミツの味(超美味しい)!
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_en: Everything Jisung eats is honey-delicious!

HEALTH_EAT.text: 지성아, 밥 잘 챙겨 먹는 게 인지상정!
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_ja: ジソン、ご飯をちゃんと食べることが当然の道理!
HEALTH_EAT.meaning_en: Jisung, it's common sense to take good care of your meals!

HEALTH_CARE.meaning_ja: ジソンの健康こそがシズニの幸せだ!
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_en: Jisung's health is immediately Czennies' happiness!

HEALTH_CARE.meaning_ja: ジソン、風邪に気をつけて! 完全に武装して!
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_en: Jisung, watch out for colds! Gear up completely!

HEALTH_CARE.meaning_ja: ジソン、病気になったらカチャンカチャン!(家に連れて帰るぞ)
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_en: Jisung, if you get sick, *clink clink*! (I'll take you home/handcuff you humorously)

HEALTH_CARE.meaning_ja: ジソンの体の健康、私が責任を持つ!
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_en: I will take responsibility for Jisung's physical health!

HEALTH_CARE.meaning_ja: コンディション管理をしっかりしよう、パク・ジソン!
HEALTH_CARE.meaning_en: Let's manage your condition well, Park Jisung!

GREET_JOB.meaning_ja: ジソン、お疲れ様! 今日のステージは過去最高!
GREET_JOB.meaning_en: Jisung, you worked hard! Today's stage was legendary!

GREET_JOB.meaning_ja: ジソンの苦労に涙がポロポロ溢れる!
GREET_JOB.meaning_en: Tears pouring out over Jisung's hard work!

GREET_JOB.meaning_ja: ジソン、今日の給料は愛だ!
GREET_JOB.meaning_en: Jisung, today's pay is love!

GREET_JOB.meaning_ja: パク・ジソン、今日のパフォーマンスはヤバかった!
GREET_JOB.meaning_en: Park Jisung, today's performance was crazy/insane!

GREET_JOB.meaning_ja: ジソン、本当にお疲れ様。ゆっくり休んで!
GREET_JOB.meaning_en: Jisung, you struggled hard. Rest well!
